dedupe_keys.name: lczexplore local climate zone comparison package

description: lczexplore is an R package published by OrbisGIS developers to compare Local Climate Zone classifications for urban climate studies. It loads geographic classifications, intersects their spatial units and produces comparison maps, agreement statistics and confusion matrices. Current documentation also describes comparisons across several maps, including pairwise agreement and consensus by class. Users can compare GeoClimate results from different source datasets or assess other geographic classifications. Geographic coverage, spatial resolution and reference dates depend on the input maps; the package itself has no fixed study period. Source code and an installation workflow are available through GitHub, with an archived release on Zenodo. Use is free under LGPL-3.0, as stated in the repository and README even though the archive omits a licence. These outputs help check the urban inputs used in heat-risk and climate-adaptation simulations. A limitation is that agreement between maps does not establish which map is correct. No directly related existing catalogue record was established. GeoClimate is a separate G5 draft. The package was not executed.
name: lczexplore Local Climate Zone comparison package
